# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 4 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** Woe to the Hypocrite in the Assembly

---

**4:1** Why do you take a seat among the devout, you defiler —
you whose heart has never known the LORD?

**4:2** You provoke the God of Israel with your transgressions,
outdoing even the wicked in your lawless deeds.

**4:3** Presumptuous in words, presumptuous in your manner —
yet the first to denounce a sinner with harsh words.

**4:4** Your hand flies up first against the accused, in mock-zeal —
while you yourself wallow in disgraceful passions.

**4:5** Your eyes prowl over every woman without restraint;
your tongue manufactures oaths it never intends to keep.

**4:6** In the dark of night, in secret, you transgress;
you are a thief behind a righteous face.

**4:7** Your eyes are everywhere — on every woman;
your tongue lies in every solemn pledge.

**4:8** O God, remove those who live in hypocrisy from among your devout ones —
those who waste their lives in the flesh of strangers.

**4:9** O God, destroy these hypocrites with decay —
for their entire life is a lie.

**4:10** God, lay their deeds bare to mockery before all Israel;
expose them as they have exposed others.

**4:11** Let poverty and want be their portion;
let them inherit nothing but emptiness.

**4:12** Let their old age find them childless;
let them die in total desolation.

**4:13** Scatter the bones of the slanderers far from those who fear the LORD;
let there be no peace in their grave.

**4:14** For with his tongue he seduces the honorable,
and with lawless words leads the simple souls astray.

**4:15** He cuts down the young men in their prime;
he destroys the beauty of young women.

**4:16** He causes the noble to stumble on secret paths —
right there in front of everyone.

**4:17** Let him be homeless and wandering the roads;
let no one ever take shelter in his house.

**4:18** Let his days on earth be few;
let his old age be nothing but shame and poverty.

**4:19** O LORD, strike down those who sit on the councils of power
who hold authority over the innocent devout.

**4:20** O God, make their dwelling a ruin;
cut off their children from the face of the earth.

**4:21** For they have deceived the souls of the righteous with lies
and led the whole house of Israel astray.

**4:22** Therefore, Lord, repay them in full;
hand them over to the power of the righteous.

**4:23** O God, keep me from the sinner
who schemes and plots against me.

**4:24** Keep the evil one far away, O LORD;
let his face be covered in shame before me.

**4:25** Guide my steps in your truth, O LORD;
do not let the wickedness of sinners overpower me.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering prioritizing poetic force and contemporary resonance. Sense-for-sense.*
